text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, they even have pouches like this! 
Hehe, so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the character design on this card case 
is so stylish! I could totally use this 
every day!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is this the new Fuwamaru plush!? I 
didn't know they made one of her! 
Waaaaahhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lying in bed, Bubblegum Fellow became 
utterly absorbed in browsing for cute 
merchandise, losing track of time late 
into the night...
